Big tech and banking earnings and Bitcoin under severe pressure
Papa John's, Navitas, Critical Metals: Trending Stocks
content.description:
Rare-earth stocks rally as tensions between the US and China rise again, with MP Materials (MP) and Critical Metals (CRML) posting big gains in pre-market. Papa John's (PZZA) keep rising on speculation surrounding a takeover bid. And in the world of tech and AI, while Navitas (NVTS) is skyrocketing following positive updates about its collaboration with Nvidia (NVDA), many other big names seem set to open in the red: notably Intel (INTC), TSMC (TSM), Alphabet (GOOG) and Broadcom (AVGO).

For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.
